summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its revolving credit facility. The amendment increases the accordion feature by $0.5 billion to up to $2.5 billion, reduces the interest rate margin by 50 basis points, and extends the maturity from April 2028 to August 2029. Borrowers are indirect subsidiaries, with Mizuho Bank as agent and KKR Capital Markets as arranger. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
